newsitem.title: SPAIN: Morris, Reynolds to lift Spain cigarette prices RP.
newsitem.headline: Morris, Reynolds to lift Spain cigarette prices RP.

text.p: Tobacco firms R.J. Reynolds, Philip Morris, and BAT are raising cigarette prices in Spain on Monday, according to the daily State Official Bulletin.
Packs of Marlboro and Winston will rise 10 to 310 pesetas ($2.38) while L&M and Gold Coast brands will rise 20 pesetas to 210 and 205, respectively, the Bulletin said.
Lucky Strike and Chesterfield brands are rising 15 pesetas a pack to 245 pesetas.
This follows the decision by Tabacalera to raise the price of its Virginia tobacco brands by 20 pesetas per pack this weekend, following a government hike in tobacco taxes on July 31.
